methodology.selection: Official Geekbench 7 OpenCL chart GPU-model scores, calculated by Primate Labs from at least five unique uploaded results per model. Preserve exact model variants; virtual partitions, PCIe/SXM differences, memory variants and workstation/server editions are not interchangeable. No score is multiplied by GPU count.
methodology.usage: A GPU-model reference score is a proxy for a single allocated matching GPU. It is not a measurement of that cloud VM. Match exact hardware variants using provider specifications; leave unverified variants unavailable. Only single-GPU allocations can use this reference without a separately measured aggregate GPU benchmark.
methodology.limitations: Scores combine different systems, operating systems, drivers and host CPUs. Cloud performance can differ. Geekbench OpenCL measures general GPU compute workloads rather than LLM throughput. This dataset is a separately versioned series and must not be mixed with Geekbench 6 GPU results. Chart values can change as uploads accumulate.
